He has only been glimpsed where the hills meet the waters, where the feet of mankind tread not. Perhaps this is why Tianshi Bureaus are often built in the mountains.

abilities.text: Attacks 2 targets simultaneously; periodically summons stationary Talismans in the 8 surrounding tiles
Fishes at 3 random Vagary Tiles, moving any hooked Operator or unit to self; if the hooked unit is an enemy unit, increases their ATK and HP and changes their route
When a long time has passed in the battle, disappears and drains 5 Life Points

enemy_2118_dylbhm.description: Build pillars and towers from clouds and earth, and make pairs out of like and like.
enemy_2118_dylbhm.lore: Build pillars and towers from clouds and earth, and make pairs out of like and like.

abilities.text: First Form
Starts with Hui attribute and attacks 2 targets simultaneously, prioritizing units with the opposite Hui-Ming Attribute
[Amalgam] Periodically enters a casting state to change his Hui-Ming Attribute
[Summon Liangs] Periodically summons Liangs from both sides of the map
Second Form
[Amalgam] Periodically enters a casting state to change his Hui-Ming Attribute and gain Barrier
[Summon Liangs] Periodically summons more Liangs from both sides of the map

enemy_2119_dyshhj.description: The manifestation of the half-awake god that was defeated by Yan's final shot. A Proxy has taken Its place and appropriated Its context, seemingly attempting to fully awaken It.
enemy_2119_dyshhj.lore: The manifestation of the half-awake god that was defeated by Yan's final shot. A Proxy has taken Its place and appropriated Its context, seemingly attempting to fully awaken It.

abilities.text: Does not normally exist on the battlefield; periodically locks on to your unit with the most nearby units, triggering [Sleepless] and remaining on the field for a while
[Sleepless] Forces the target and your units in the 8 surrounding tiles to retreat, creating undeployable tiles for a while
[Shake the Mountains] After [Sleepless] is triggered, slams the ground three times, dealing high Physical damage to all your units, ignoring Camouflage
Triggers a [Sleepless] that forces all units to retreat when HP drops below a certain level
When a long time has passed in the battle, triggers [Sleepless] before disappearing and draining 50 Life Points

enemy_2120_dywqgs.description: The strategist, the sinner, the chess piece laid at the Tomb of Sui.
enemy_2120_dywqgs.lore: The strategist, the sinner, the chess piece laid at the Tomb of Sui.

abilities.text: Initial Form
[Placement] Whenever you deploy a unit, deploy a 'Flaw' in one of the 4 adjacent deployable tiles around it
[Placement] Periodically deploys a 'Flaw' on a deployable tile in one of the 4 adjacent tiles around your units that does not already have a unit
First Form
Nearby 'Flaws' will recover a percentage of HP every second and attack nearby your units, stunning them
For every nearby 'Flaw', Physical and Arts damage taken is reduced, and control effect duration is reduced
[Ladder] When a target on the field is 'Emptied', enters full-screen attack mode, prioritizing surrounded targets and attacking up to 3 targets at a time
Second Form
Deploys multiple 'Flaws' when entering second form; if a deployable tile surrounded by 'Flaws' does not have a unit, it will begin to spawn enemies continuously
After reviving, deploys a 'Flaw' on deployable tiles around your units
Leaves the field when the last 'Flaw' is defeated

enemy_2123_dyjsww.description: Of the same form as the earth, of the same height as the mountains. None amongst the many are its equal, and its name is Hou.
enemy_2123_dyjsww.lore: Of the same form as the earth, of the same height as the mountains. None amongst the many are its equal, and its name is Hou.

abilities.text: First Form
[Inaction] Cannot be attacked; enters 2nd form when Bestial Ju is defeated or leaves the field, or when enough time has elapsed, activating all Ancient Statuegeists on the field

[Timeshift] Periodically teleports to a certain tile, reducing the ASPD of your units deployed in the opposite direction of its movement, and increasing the Movement Speed of enemy units moving in the same direction
[Transmogrification] When touched by an enemy other than Bestial Ju, removes them from the field, deducts 1 Life Point, deals Arts damage to all your units, and permanently gains increased ATK

[Altruism] Periodically locks on to one of your Operators parallel to it and attacks in a straight line, dealing splash Arts damage to the first Operator hit, and deploying an Ancient Statuegeist on a nearby passable tile
Second Form

[Transmogrification] Causes all enemies other than Bestial Ju to move towards this unit until it is defeated or leaves the field; when touched by an enemy other than Bestial Ju, removes them from the field, deducts 1 Life Point, deals Arts damage to all your units, and permanently gains increased ATK
[Timeshift] Periodically reduces the ASPD of your units deployed in the opposite direction of its movement, and increasing the Movement Speed of enemy units moving in the same direction
When a long time has passed in the battle, disappears and drains 50 Life Points

enemy_2124_dyjsfg.description: Bring unity and order, halt conflict and quell disaster. It is upright and unyielding, and its name is Ju.
enemy_2124_dyjsfg.lore: Bring unity and order, halt conflict and quell disaster. It is upright and unyielding, and its name is Ju.

abilities.text: [Sober] Duration of negative statuses such as Stun, Cold, and Freeze greatly reduced; Physical and Arts damage taken greatly reduced; damage reduction effect reduced when blocked or prevented from moving
[Concordance] Continuously deals Physical damage around itself, and deals one instance of heavy Physical damage around itself whenever it is blocked
[Unlife] When HP drops below 50% for the first time, gains increased Block cost, ATK, and Movement Speed

[Benevolence] When defeated or on leaving the field, removes all enemies other than Bestial Hou from the field, and deals one instance of heavy Physical damage to all your units, ignoring Invisibility

enemy_2126_dycyue.description: A vessel that has been annexed, containing all malice and wrath. Its original owner slumbers eternal, replaced by—
enemy_2126_dycyue.lore: A vessel that has been annexed, containing all malice and wrath. Its original owner slumbers eternal, replaced by—

abilities.text: [Violence] Chance to dodge Physical and Arts damage from units who are not blocking this unit; ATK increased for every 'Olden Pride' in the Deployment Waiting Zone
[Drunken Stupor] Adds an 'Olden Pride' to the Deployment Waiting Zone
[Tracing the Law] Spawns 'Restrained Pride' at current location, and spawns another 'Restrained Pride' for every 'Olden Pride' in the Deployment Waiting Zone
[Depict] Summons a 'Body' segment, forcing units on it to retreat; cannot be attacked while 'Body' is on the field
[Wisdom] Physical and Arts damage taken reduced by 50% for every 'Body' segment on the field
[Flame of Intrigue] Adds an 'Olden Grudge' to the Deployment Waiting Zone
[Build Foundation] Summons a 'Body' segment; summons 'Body' every time it loses a certain amount of HP
[Purifying Flame] Spawns 'Fume of Anger' at current location, and spawns another 'Fume of Anger' for every 'Olden Grudge' in the Deployment Waiting Zone
[Woven Prison] Continuously casts, summoning multiple 'Fumes of Anger' to attack the target
Leave the field and drains 50 Life Points after a long time has passed in the battle

enemy_6004_pleslm.description: A domestic Originium Slug that escaped into the wild. Despite its tremendous size and sturdy crystal back, it is not aggressive and extremely good at 'interacting' with people.
enemy_6004_pleslm.lore: A domestic Originium Slug that escaped into the wild before mutating in a high-pressure environment. Despite its tremendous size and sturdy crystal back, it is not aggressive and extremely good at 'interacting' with people. It still views them the same way it did when it was merely a house pet, but what was once playful is now truly destructive at its new size.

abilities.text: When HP drops under half, gains greatly increased ATK and takes reduced Physical and Arts damage
Adds a Contaminated Mineral to the Deployment Waiting Zone (maximum of one)
Adds a Heat Cluster to the Preparation Area (When transferred, deals True damage to all allied units and Stuns them for several seconds)

enemy_6005_llstone.description: An Originium Arts construct made from mining waste. It has raided many mines, and people fearfully call it the 'Mine Killing Mine'.
enemy_6005_llstone.lore: An Originium Arts construct made from mining waste, originally created to maximize the value of the mines. However, this colossus seems to have realized its own origins, and refused to take part in any mining activities before finally turning against the very people who created it. It has raided many mines, and people fearfully call it the 'Mine Killing Mine.'

abilities.text: Deals a small amount of Arts damage to surrounding units
Applies a Crude Sphere to the operator with the highest ATK on the field
Randomly applies a Crude Sphere to an Operator in the Deployment Waiting Zone

enemy_6007_mtslm.description:
Very high DEF, splits into 5 Fluorescent Originium Slugs when defeated;
periodically adds 'Fluorescent Spores' to the Deployment Area, and if there is no space, they will be instead added to the Recuperation Area.
enemy_6007_mtslm.lore: This massive fluorescent Originium slug carries an enormous number of larvae in the interstices along its massive mantle, making it travel extremely slowly. This type of Originium slug lives deep underground all year round, so it's impossible to guess why it has appeared here. Though not hostile, it has devoured a large quantity of discarded ores and grown massive in size, significantly interfering with the cleanup process.

abilities.text: Splits into 5 Fluorescent Originium Slugs upon death
Periodically adds Fluorescent Spores to the Deployment Waiting Zone, and if there is no space, they will be instead added to the Recuperation Area

enemy_6009_nlkgtbs.description: Giant Gloompincer with tentacle-shaped mouthparts, increasing its feeding efficiency.
enemy_6009_nlkgtbs.lore: Giant Gloompincer with tentacle-shaped mouthparts, increasing its feeding efficiency. It indiscriminately devours the materials left on the industrial platform, and the resulting chemical reactions in its internal organs have turned the cleanup operation into a putrid nightmare.

abilities.text: Can release 1 type of industrial material when Danger Level increases
Reduce damage taken, but damage reduction does not work on units blocking it
Gains a Barrier equal to a percentage of current max HP when HP drops below 25% for the first time.

enemy_6010_boxing.description: The organizer of the barrenlands boxing competition. When blocked, takes reduced damage from all units other than the blocker. Returns to the ring when defeated.
enemy_6010_boxing.lore: An old underground boxer from Rim Billiton, nicknamed from his debut fight as a youth, where he defeated an older champion hungry for competition. Many years later, he lost to someone even younger than him, and left for the wilderness in anger. Relying on his cunning and life experiences over the years, he became a boxing fixer in the wilderness, and even had the beautiful dream of snatching some land in a nomadic city to build a underground boxing arena, but he had no idea that the key to success or failure was never in his hands to begin with.

abilities.text: Takes less damage from all units other than the blocker when blocked
Gets knocked down to rest when health drops to a certain percentage; when all HP is restored, gets up again and ASPD increases.

enemy_6011_planty.description: A newly-discovered lifeform that can disseminate pollen to spawn more [Small Symbionts]
enemy_6011_planty.lore: A newly discovered life form and the largest Originium Slug and flower symbiote on reliable record. Capable of boosting plant growth and Originium Slug reproduction by dispersing its pollen, it can even fly slowly in the air. Some scholars believe that its ability to fly is new evidence of unintelligent organisms actively manipulating complex Originium Arts, while others believe it is nothing more than a naturally occurring phenomenon under hyper-specific conditions. This question has yet to be resolved, as no biologist has been desperate enough to approach it.

abilities.text: Consumes lifeforce while flying over ground tiles and causes vegetation to grow on tiles it travels over; falls to the ground when HP reaches half
[Growth Hormone] While flying, covers surrounding tiles with vegetation that summons Small Symbionts
[Deciduous Hormone] When Operators are transferred, attacks the Operator on the field with the highest DEF and places a [Modified Phytohormone] into the Deployment Waiting Zone

enemy_6013_smith.description: Former Mama John's employee. No one knows what she's been through the past few years, but it's clear she doesn't have a favorable impression of her Mama's huge family.
enemy_6013_smith.lore: Former Mama John's employee. No one knows what she's been through the past few years, but it's clear she doesn't have a favorable impression of her Mama's huge family. She's now brandishing an arsenal of weapons built by her construction crew, and recklessly destroying her Mama's new plate.

abilities.text: Invulnerable for a period of time after appearing on the field
Periodically summons a hidden Full-Auto Debit Machine that periodically consumes DP
When Danger Level increases, summons a hidden Post-Firing Debt Relief Program that fires long-ranged attacks in a set direction

enemy_6014_crzgas.description: A bona fide thug from the barrenlands, head to toe.
enemy_6014_crzgas.lore: A bona fide thug from the barrenlands, head to toe. They once merely wandered the wilds, but after spotting a Raythean Industries test platform dealing with a gas leakage, they've decided to risk it all and take over the entire platform to make their fortune.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Whenever a certain percentage of HP is lost, permanently increases the damage inflicted by Poison Haze
Periodically sends a Rupturing Canister to the Preparation Area (grants Invisibility to all enemies except 'Tumor' when dispatched)

enemy_6015_ictruck.description: Always stirring the milk slurry within itself, and ready to flash a smile at any customer who comes into view.
enemy_6015_ictruck.lore: A fully automatic ice cream truck made to ensure a steady supply of ice cream. It lost control after a worker accidentally poured syrup into its fuel tank, overriding the core control platform and spraying ice cream everywhere. It is always stirring the milk slurry within itself, and is ready to flash a smile at any customer who comes into view.

abilities.text: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
Periodically dispatches a Supersweetie Delivery Drone towards a target, prioritizing Operators on high ground
After being on the field for a period of time, periodically increases the Movement Speed and ASPD of all enemies on the field when not blocked
Periodically enters Speeding Mode. Can no longer be blocked, and deals Physical damage by colliding with allied units
Exits Speeding Mode only after colliding 5 times with an Operator with a Block count of 4 and higher; will stop and be inflicted with Fragile for a short period, and Stuns all enemies on the field

enemy_6016_splash.description: It has returned to dry land once more, thirstier than ever.
enemy_6016_splash.lore: It once bore an Iberian name, until it tossed that name into the sea and disappeared into the abyss. However, embracing the seawater was not enough to moisten its parched throat, and the clear red liquid flowing within its veins is equally enticing, so it has returned to dry land once more, thirstier than ever.

abilities.text: Attacks inflict additional Nervous Impairment
Has high DEF and RES, but those can be reduced by healing Absorbers to full HP
Spits out filth at set intervals, placing an Absorber in the Deployment Waiting Zone and attacking several operators on the field; number of operators attacked increases according to Danger Level

After losing a certain percentage of HP, immediately Stuns multiple Operators on the field and creates a Barrier equal to the HP lost; if the Barrier is not destroyed before it expires, the Barrier shatters and inflicts a large amount of Nervous Impairment to all Operators on the field

When it creates a Barrier for the second time and thereafter, it will stun more Operators if the previous Barrier was not destroyed; this effect can stack up to a number of times, and resets when a Barrier is destroyed

enemy_6018_carrier.description: An airborne command center for agricultural drones. Malware has turned its loneliness into hatred for all who dwell on the ground.
enemy_6018_carrier.lore: An airborne command center for agricultural drones. Long has it tended the crops in the field, even treating them as its own, but it is nevertheless lonely because of its rootless wandering. Malware has turned its loneliness into hatred for all who dwell on the ground.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Periodically summons drones at its location
When there are drones nearby, gain Invisible

[Spread Malice] Summons several Seeding Drones and temporarily gives all drones within an area extra ATK and HP. If there are no nearby Seeding Drones when skill ends, stops moving and temporarily gains Fragile

enemy_6020_orang.description: The 'ultimate automaton' developed by the Liquor Association, with the power to 'squash ten kegs at the same time.'
enemy_6020_orang.lore: The 'ultimate automaton' developed by the Liquor Association, with the power to 'squash ten kegs at the same time.' In accordance with an environmental protection pact with Acahualla, the armor plates are made from recycled kegs. Considered one of the competition's favorites, it went berserk when champagne from the opening ceremony seeped into its control chip.

abilities.text: Immune to Stun, Frozen, Levitate, Sleep; temporarily loses immunity when affected by Long Live Mead!
ATK increased after each attack (with stack limit), resets after some time without attacking

[Aged Mead] Throws Aged Mead at one of your Operators after losing a percentage of HP. The Operator is Stunned while Aged Mead is on the battlefield. Aged Mead can be attacked and is added to the Deployment Waiting Zone as Long Live Mead! when defeated
Periodically targets one of your units and throws a can after a delay, dealing Physical splash damage and inflictingStun

enemy_6022_m2cnt.description: A frustrated noble who rules over a town on the borders of Leithanien. ATK increases when Squeaking Sound is on the battlefield, and takes True damage when Squeaking Sound is destroyed.
enemy_6022_m2cnt.lore: A frustrated noble who rules over a town on the borders of Leithanien. His dream was for his music to be recognized throughout, but a lack of appreciation drove him to solitude and madness. Now, he weaves his music into his Arts, spreading mournful notes in search of resonance.

abilities.text: Takes greatly reduced Physical and Arts damage.
ATK increases with the number of Squeaking Sounds on the battlefield.
Takes True damage whenever a Squeaking Sound is destroyed.
Places a Squeaking Sound in the Deployment Waiting Zone upon entering the battlefield or casting [Mourning Fugue]. Two are placed instead if HP is below 50%.

[Mourning Fugue] Stops attacking to begin casting. While casting, Squeaking Sounds are no longer invulnerable, and Arts damage is dealt around this unit and all Squeaking Sounds over time. While casting, Squeaking Sounds in the Deployment Waiting Zone also drain DP.

enemy_6023_crane.description: The secret weapon of Box Inc., and the natural enemy of 'Unruly Creatures.' Looks like a claw machine. Max HP, DEF, and ATK are greatly increased when loaded with an enemy.
enemy_6023_crane.lore: The secret weapon of Box Inc., and the natural enemy of 'Unruly Creatures.' Looks like a claw machine. Its program has gone haywire, causing it to run amok on the streets of Dossoles, snatching anything within reach. Keep your distance and resist the lure of its glowing neon signs, lest it swallow you too!

abilities.text: Loads nearby non-Leader enemies inside as passengers (max 5). Throws 1 passenger when attacking. All passengers are unloaded when this unit is defeated.
ATK, DEF, and HP greatly increased when passengers are loaded.
When 'Really Unruly Creature' is loaded, unloads all passengers and becomes stunned for an extended period.
[Right-Right-Up-Left] Stops moving but significantly increases its attack range and ASPD for the duration, and immediately draws several nearby enemies to its location.

[Redeem Prize] Binds the Operator with the highest ATK, preventing it from attacking and using skills until this unit leaves the battlefield. Places a 'Really Unruly Creature' and Sticky Prize in the Deployment Waiting Zone when effect expires.

enemy_6025_tinker.description: A war altar imbued with Sarkaz witchcraft, firing witchcraft missiles over the entire battlefield.
enemy_6025_tinker.lore: A war altar imbued with Sarkaz witchcraft. Once abandoned in the ruins of battle, it has been resurrected. Now, the earth trembles in its might and no living being is safe around it. It seeks neither preservation nor remembrance—only a fight to the very end. Surrounded by its creations, it will not go down alone.

abilities.text: Enters into defensive mode when HP drops below 60% for the first time, gaining temporary Arts and Physical damage reduction, and summoning Witchcraft Orbs.
Periodically fires many witchcraft missiles across the entire field, dealing Physical damage to your units. Prioritizes the 2 allied units closest to it.
Periodically summons Witchcraft Orbs in the 4 adjacent tiles.

enemy_6027_bqthie.description: A Qinggong master known for her agility and grace on the rooftops of Yumen. With her hook claw, she soars from one high ground to another.
enemy_6027_bqthie.lore: A Qinggong master renowned for her agility and grace on the rooftops of Yumen. Though her motivations remain unknown, her actions reveal an honorable nature. Her steps are light, her gaze piercing. Yet, it is a pity that her role seems as insignificant as a leaf in the wind.

abilities.text: Normally stationary; moves to a different High Ground with her claw hook after some time has elapsed, or if a certain amount of HP is lost. This unit is Aerial while moving.
Periodically hides 'Indisputable Evidence' in your Preparation Area, and reduces DP Cost.
Periodically destroys 1 Indisputable Evidence and performs a powerful attack.
For each Indisputable Evidence, increases ATK while gaining Physical and Arts dodge.
ASPD significantly increases when unblocked.

enemy_6028_cosgia.description: Old Gramophone that has long lay abandoned in the wilderness, until the song of the pack once again brought life to this place.
enemy_6028_cosgia.lore: Old Gramophone that has long lay abandoned in the wilderness, until the song of the pack once again brought life to this place. It was repaired by music lovers to lead the song of the pack, but the conflicting tastes of the aficionados and their uneven skills at reverse-engineering Originium circuits have caused its programming to run amok.

abilities.text: First Form
Disguised as an occupied L-44 Gramophone; Cannot be attacked
At a certain time, rises and transforms into its second form, leaving behind the Gramophone pedestal; Transforms immediately if the disguised L-44 Gramophone is occupied by allied units
Second Form
Whenever the Danger Level increases, gains a Barrier that absorbs Physical and Arts damage

enemy_6029_solzac.description: A set of chime bells that turned into Waregeist. Its previous owner was a musician whose deathbed request was for Miss Du to deliver it to a friend. It was transformed into a Waregeist by the influence of Sui-Xiang after it was stolen.
enemy_6029_solzac.lore: A set of chime bells that turned into a Waregeist. Its previous owner was a musician whose deathbed request was for Miss Du to deliver it to a friend. After it was stolen, it was transformed into a Waregeist by the influence of Sui-Xiang. It makes a poignant sound as it wanders about trying to return to its master, not knowing that its master has already passed away.

abilities.text: Initial Form
Throws 'Woodthreads' at one of your Operators after losing a percentage of HP; the Operator is Stunned while 'Woodthreads' is on the battlefield
Reborn Form
When HP is reduced to 0, remains Invulnerable and splits into a large number of 'Twitter'; [Reborn Form] expires when there are no 'Twitter' on the battlefield
Returns to initial form if 'Aubade' HP is not at 0 when [Reborn Form] expires
ATK increases when returning from [Reborn Form] to initial form

enemy_6032_fxdjj.description: Security robot developed by a Dossoles startup specifically for Galería Krysztauowa.
enemy_6032_fxdjj.lore: Security robot developed by a Dossoles startup specifically for Galería Krysztauowa. They were deep in debt and were counting on this contract to turn things around. Reynell promised to pay within three days of delivery, but never paid a single coin until the company was leveled by the collectors' bulldozers. In fact, he has never even taken this labor of love out of its box—perhaps he just wanted to see smart people driven to madness. Who can possibly know the answer?

abilities.text: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
Has a shield and always faces the last deployed unit, greatly reducing Physical and Arts damage taken from the front
Danger Level rises faster when attacked from the direction of the shield
After moving to a specific location, leaves behind an 'Unwavering Assistant' that faces the same direction with continuously increasing ATK, dealing Physical splash damage

Stops attacking and begins charging when Danger Level increases or when losing a percentage of HP; after charging for a while, performs a special attack against all your units, dealing increased damage to units behind the shield, inflicting Stun

enemy_6033_skagod.description: This massive beast is no longer recognizable.
enemy_6033_skagod.lore: This massive beast is no longer recognizable. It is a cave-dwelling creature with poor vision and a passion for digging its nest. Covered in frigid scales, it moves by curling up and rolling wherever it needs to go.

abilities.text: Gains status resistance and gains Physical and Arts Dodge based on current Movement Speed

[Whirlwind Smash] Curls into a ball and dashes forward for a distance based on current Movement Speed, stunning Operators around the tiles it passes through for several seconds, and dealing Physical damage based on Movement Speed; immune to most control effects while skill is active, and Movement Speed is permanently increased when skill expires. The Stun effect is enhanced based on the number of times the skill is activated
Gradually accelerates and enters 'roll form' when unblocked; the first attack after entering 'roll form' triggers [Whirlwind Smash]
Triggers [Whirlwind Smash] after being blocked for some time
[Whirlwind Smash] cooldown resets immediately when Danger Level increases, or when a certain amount of HP is lost

enemy_7009_mtmoun.description: A warrior of unknown background who wears exquisite but tattered armor. He strides forward, sand cupped within his hands, no longer responsive to anyone.
enemy_7009_mtmoun.lore: A warrior of unknown background who wears exquisite but tattered armor. He strides forward, sand cupped within his hands, no longer responsive to anyone.

abilities.text: Normally does not attack, but counters when attacked
Recovers a percentage of its own HP when an allied unit is retreated or defeated within range

enemy_7010_bldrgn.description: When attacked, takes flight for a period of time and switches to a long-ranged attack that inflicts Burn
enemy_7010_bldrgn.lore: An extremely silent Great Wingbeast. This Infected creature has a pair of crystallized wings bigger than its body, but cannot fly too high or for too long. A ferocious carnivore, but this one seems to have had its meal, and is merely curious about the tiny things that have appeared before it.

abilities.text: Normally does not attack, but counters when attacked.
Can turn into an aerial unit for a period of time
When flying, deals ranged splash Arts damage, also inflicting Burn

enemy_7012_wilder.description: The advance linebreaker officer under the command of a Sargonian Lord Ameer. He cares for nothing but removing all obstacles in his way, fearing neither life nor death.
enemy_7012_wilder.lore: The advance linebreaker officer under the command of a Sargonian Lord Ameer. He cares for nothing but removing all obstacles in his way, fearing neither life nor death. He is the strongest and bravest soldier in the entire army.

abilities.text: First Form
When not blocked, damage taken is significantly reduced
Second Form
Gains greatly increased ATK, ASPD, and Movement Speed

enemy_7013_slwazd.description: An elite Caster honored by the local Lord Ameer, capable of manipulating Infected creatures to fight.
enemy_7013_slwazd.lore: An elite Caster honored by the local Lord Ameer, capable of manipulating Infected creatures to fight. Destroying their enemies is merely a side effect of the ultimate destruction that they wish to see.

abilities.text: Less likely to be attacked
First Form
Summons 2 Infused Originium Slugs for assistance
Second Form
Summons 2 Infused Originium Slugs and 2 Infused Originium Slug αs

enemy_7014_dva.description: The suit personally assembled and piloted by the elite battlesuit technician of the Lord Ameer's army.
enemy_7014_dva.lore: Elite armored corps of a Lord Ameer operating their self-assembled armor. Its self-destruct system is the only part they are unsatisfied with, and it is obvious they care more about their beloved machine than the Lord Ameer's orders.

abilities.text: First Form
Can only be blocked by units with at least 2 Block
After 3 attacks, the next attack deals heavy Splash Physical damage
When defeated deals Physical damage and Stuns surrounding allied units for a few seconds
Second Form
Pilot does not attack nor move, becomes Invisible, and reflects physical damage while repairing the mech
After some time, they return to the mech and it returns to its first form

enemy_8001_flmlod_3.description: From the youngest general of the Punishment Clan, to the final Diαblo. Facing the siege, he guarded the king's remains for three days and nights. Finally, in the final flame's light, he saw his promised homeland.
enemy_8001_flmlod_3.lore: From the youngest general of the Punishment Clan, to the final Diαblo. Facing the siege, he guarded the king's remains for three days and nights. Finally, in the final flame's light, he saw his promised homeland.

abilities.text: First Form

[Suppression] Uses Haunting Flames to incapacitate one Operator on the field, causing them to be unable to act and take continuous Arts damage. If an Operator is defeated or retreats while affected by Haunting Flames, that Operator will be sealed, and cannot be redeployed until the Haunting Flames are destroyed.

[Payback] When HP drops to 0, all surrounding Operators will immediately be engulfed by Haunting Flames. Periodically releases Condensed Heat towards a friendly unit (if no eligible targets, this will be released towards the Objective Points instead).

[Condensed Heat] These flying flames released by Sverdsmeltr have low DEF and inflict continuous Arts and Burn to surrounding Operators. When they reach their target or the target leaves the field, they will self-destruct and deal Arts damage in a large area. Drains a Life Point upon reaching the Objective Point.
Second Form
Sverdsmeltr summons his Reforged Retinue and flies into the air. During this period, he will periodically release Condensed Heat towards a friendly unit nearby.

When all Reforged Retinues are defeated or when Sverdsmeltr falls below 50% HP, Sverdsmeltr will absorb all remaining Reforged Retinues and restore HP. Afterward, he will land on the ground, where he deals long-ranged AoE Arts attacks and gains the following abilities:

[Extinction] Incapacitates one Operator on the field, causing them to be unable to act and releasing Condensed Heat at them. This Condensed Heat has higher HP and damage, and destroying it will allow the targeted Operator to resume acting.
[Sunwielder's Sanctuary] After using [Extinction], gains an Arts Barrier. While the Barrier persists, grants significantly increased DEF to self and deals Arts and Burn to surrounding allied units.

enemy_8007_eltrsm_3.description: A Breakthrough Trainer simulating Rosmontis at the peak of her combat prowess. Fights by flinging Vector Tactical Equipment (V.T.E.), which can stun allies within its radius.
enemy_8007_eltrsm_3.lore:
A Breakthrough Trainer simulating Rosmontis at the peak of her combat prowess.
As she gazes at the 'walking arsenal' brought to life from data, her memories are finally liberated. Braver and more determined, she now yearns to fight alongside her companions.

abilities.text: [Mind Matrix] Takes less Physical and Arts damage. Loses this effect when the V.T.E. on the field is destroyed and cannot attack until the V.T.E. is re-obtained.
First Form

[Fling] Hurls a V.T.E. at an allied unit regardless of distance, dealing 3 instances of Physical damage to the target when it lands (The second and third instances are aftershocks, dealing half damage). Stunned targets are instantly defeated.
[Retrieve] Clears all Matrices on the field and retrieves all Tactical Equipment.
[Impulse Inhibition] Initiates revival when HP reaches 0, periodically dealing Arts damage over a wide area around her every few seconds during the process.
Second Form
[Amplified Fling] Hurls a second V.T.E. a few seconds after the first. Stunned targets are instantly defeated.
[Memory Loss] Loses a certain amount of HP with every attack and deals Arts damage over a wide area around her.
[Cognitive Collapse] Once HP drops below 50%, flies into the air and switches to ranged attacks. Increases ATK, no longer uses [Fling], and gains the following abilities:

Attacks stun the target for an extended period. [Mind Matrix] effect no longer expires and reduces damage taken even further. [Memory Loss] damage dealt and HP loss are both increased. When attacked, deals a certain amount of True damage to surrounding allies.

enemy_8010_mcnist_3.description: A Breakthrough Trainer simulating Mechanist at the peak of his combat prowess.
enemy_8010_mcnist_3.lore:
A Breakthrough Trainer simulating Mechanist at the peak of his combat prowess.
The engineer famous for his memory and scientific rigor can also write words as romantic as 'Love is like the second law of thermodynamics: the more one longs for eternity, the further one goes down the path of decline,' when he is drunk enough.

abilities.text: [Self-Defense Arts] Periodically gains a shield that protects against Physical and Arts damage, which is broken after taking a certain number of attacks
First Form
When HP is reduced to 0, if Structural Principle is alive on the field, summons drones to restore HP and revives when HP is at max

[Organically Linked Formula] Fights in concert with Structural Principle. When shield is broken or HP is reduced to 0, Structural Principle is stunned, and [Reactive Defense Module] is temporarily disabled.
[Concentration Algorithm] Locks onto a target and bombards it, dealing Physical damage to it and units in the 8 surrounding tiles several times

When Mechanist, Mechanical Mind and Structural Principle are both waiting to be revived, activates [Nirvana Program]: Locks onto the target with the highest Block every few seconds and attacks them, reduces their Max Block, each attack dealing Arts damage to all your units on the same row or column with the target. Enters second form when program is terminated
Second Form

[Engineering Meteor Shower] Attacks the blocker continuously when Structural Principle is blocked, dealing Arts damage to all your units on the same row or column with the blocker, and temporarily reducing their Max Block
Activates [Nirvana Program] again when HP drops below 50% for the first time

enemy_8011_mcndog_3.description: A risk assessment machine built by Mechanist. His best friend.
enemy_8011_mcndog_3.lore:
A risk assessment machine built by Mechanist. His best friend.
He set twenty defensive programs to prevent Closure from meddling with it.

abilities.text: When HP is reduced to 0, if Mechanist, Mechanical Mind is alive on the field, summons drones to restore HP and revives when HP is at max
First Form
[Reactive Defense Module] Gains increased DEF and RES when damage is taken; buff quickly degrades several seconds after the last damage is taken
[Focus Module] Attacks inflict additional Corrosion and continuously gains ASPD when attacking the same target (capped); resets when switching targets or not attacking for a few seconds
Second Form
[Acceleration Module] Gradually accelerates when moving, and deals additional damage on the first attack after being blocked based upon Movement Speed

enemy_8016_misery.description: A Breakthrough Trainer simulating Misery at the peak of his combat prowess.
enemy_8016_misery.lore:
A Breakthrough Trainer simulating Misery at the peak of his combat prowess.
A stealth specialist who excels in spatial Arts, he toys with the dagger in his hand as he keeps opponents distracted. Beware, he's not especially fond of being called an 'assassin'.

abilities.text: 100% Physical and Arts dodge when on a tile shrouded by night
[Instant Scar] Deals heavy Physical damage to the Operator with lowest Max HP; targets defeated this way have greatly increased Redeployment Time; target loses visibility if hit 3 times in a row
[Dissolution Space] When affected by Stun, Cold, Freeze, Fear, Lure, or Shifted, immediately removes the condition, recovers HP, and becomes immune to these effects for several seconds

When defeated for the first time, returns to the field and changes behavior: When entering your visibility, immediately moves to a tile shrouded by night and stops moving (no allies in path); continues moving after casting [Instant Scar], or if he does not find a target
[Diffuse Fission] Attacks and [Instant Scar] deal continuous Arts damage, and targets that leave the field while effect is active have greatly increased Redeployment Time

enemy_7022_gatgod.description: As her HP being reduced, her damage taken from units not blocked by herself is also gradually reduced to 0; when launching continuous attacks, ATK increases (resets when Frozen, Stunned, or Levitated)
enemy_7022_gatgod.lore: A priestess whose allure reflects her power. The more eye-catching her flowers, the sharper her blade.

abilities.text: As her HP being reduced, her damage taken from units not blocked by herself is also gradually reduced to 0
Gains increased ATK when making consecutive attacks. (Resets when affected by Freeze, Stun, or Levitate)

enemy_7024_clking.description: Deals heavy Burn to nearby units every second, and recovers a huge amount of HP every second
enemy_7024_clking.lore: No matter where they go, the troubadours who cross the barrens to entertain others will always be surrounded by graceful, flickering flames and deafening cheers.

abilities.text: Deals heavy Burn to nearby units every second, and recovers a huge amount of HP every second
Become Silenced during the Wet Season or when Frozen

enemy_7026_xbele.description: Nobody knows when this colossus was created. It responds to time with silence, its fists acting as their persevering faith.
enemy_7026_xbele.lore: Nobody knows when this colossus was created. It responds to time with silence, its fists acting as their persevering faith.

abilities.text: Normally does not attack, but counters when attacked
After 2 attacks, the next attack deals heavy Physical damage to targets within range and inflicts Stun
When HP falls below 50%, gains significantly increased ASPD

enemy_7027_xbbtl.description: An unusual lifeform that appears in crystal caves. It endeavored and molted into the sturdiest of shells, yet still cannot escape its enemy's ruthless pursuit.
enemy_7027_xbbtl.lore: An unusual lifeform that appears in crystal caves. It endeavored and molted into the sturdiest of shells, yet still cannot escape its enemy's ruthless pursuit. Forever at odds with Crystalline Oberobeasts.

abilities.text: Periodically gains a Shield that blocks damage; the Shield lasts for 80 attacks before breaking
When below 50% HP, attacks all units within Attack Range at the same time

enemy_7028_xbscp.description: An unusual lifeform that appears in crystal caves. It resembles a metal crab with sharper pincers, allowing it to easily tear its prey apart. Forever foes with Crystalline Titanibeasts.
enemy_7028_xbscp.lore: An unusual lifeform that appears in crystal caves. It resembles a metal crab with sharper pincers, allowing it to easily tear its prey apart. Forever foes with Crystalline Titanibeasts.

abilities.text: Attacks strike twice; when below 50% HP, attacks strike 4 times instead
Reduces the target's DEF with each attack
Upon approaching a Crystalline Titanibeast, instantly slays it and obtains some of its abilities; afterwards, each attack now strikes 4 times

enemy_7029_pilot.description: One of Sargonian Lords Ameer's subordinate. They always appear in unexpected places, ripping opposing frontlines apart as they roam the land.
enemy_7029_pilot.lore: One of Sargonian Lords Ameer's subordinate. They always appear in unexpected places, ripping opposing frontlines apart as they roam the land.

abilities.text: Low-Altitude Hovering; has increased Attack Range while in Low-Altitude Hovering
Attacks deal Arts splash damage
Crashes upon losing a certain percentage of HP, dealing heavy damage in an area and Stunning itself
After a period of time, reenters Low-Altitude Hovering status

enemy_7030_skodo.description: One of Sargonian Lords Ameer's subordinate. Sand pervades sky, dust obstructs sun. Life collapses, evil flourishes.
enemy_7030_skodo.lore: One of Sargonian Lords Ameer's subordinate. Sand pervades sky, dust obstructs sun. Life collapses, evil flourishes.

abilities.text: [Sandstorm's Dustwake] Increases the Movement Speed and ASPD of enemies within a certain range (including self)
Devours the blocker when blocked (up to a maximum of 3), and increases the effect of [Sandstorm's Dustwake]

enemy_7031_ghking.description: Time and time again it grows weaker, and yet it gets back up every time. This is the Annihilator—this is Sargon.
enemy_7031_ghking.lore: Time and time again it grows weaker, and yet it gets back up every time. This is the Annihilator—this is Sargon.

abilities.text: First Form
[Annihilation] Causes the next attack to Stun the target, and makes itself unblockable by allied Operators and Summons; deals a large amount of Arts damage when passing through allied units
Second Form
Increases ATK and ASPD

enemy_7054_xbsmi.description: Spreads vanilla seeds from the air, bringing the scent of revival to war-scarred Arsalan.
enemy_7054_xbsmi.lore: Spreads vanilla seeds from the air, bringing the scent of revival to war-scarred Arsalan.

abilities.text: Exotic Beast, Aerial
Tiles it passes through become seeded. Enemies on seeded tiles have increased ASPD.
Seeds nearby tiles and deals a percentage of Arts damage to all nearby allied units whenever a certain amount of HP is lost. Additionally, temporarily reduces Physical and Arts damage taken.
Stops attacking and using skills when HP drops below a certain threshold, instead flying towards the objective. Upon reaching the objective, disappears and moves to another stage.

[Rampant Growth] Periodically selects several Operators (prioritizing those on seeded tiles), dealing a percentage of ATK as Arts splash damage. Defeated targets have significantly longer Redeployment Time.

[Seed of Life] Gains the following ability in Strange Territory Difficulty 6: Enemies on seeded tiles self-destruct when defeated, dealing a percentage of their ATK as Arts damage to nearby allied units and stunning them for several seconds.

enemy_7056_xbsmiz.description: Spreads vanilla seeds from the air, bringing the scent of revival to war-scarred Arsalan.
enemy_7056_xbsmiz.lore: Spreads vanilla seeds from the air, bringing the scent of revival to war-scarred Arsalan.

abilities.text: Aerial, helps your side when on the field; does not attack building materials.
Tiles it passes through become seeded. Allies on seeded tiles have increased ASPD, and deal increased damage to Monoliths, Strange Ore Veins, and mechanical enemies.
[Rampant Growth] Plants flowers on several allies, reducing their Redeployment Time after their next retreat.
Rarer species have increased stats and enhanced [Rampant Growth] Redeployment Time reduction.

enemy_7057_xbrok.description: 'The ground's shaking! The ground's quaking! The ground's...'
enemy_7057_xbrok.lore: 'The ground's shaking! It's quaking! It's...' Before the observer can finish, the Quicksand Beast has already closed the distance. Its long maw easily cleaves through rocks, while a casual flick of its tail stirs up dust clouds. Within seconds, it burrows deep beneath the rock layers, leaving only dusty faces.

abilities.text: Exotic Beast, unblockable.
Movement speed gradually increases while moving (up to a max). Upon colliding with allied units, deals Physical damage equal to a percentage of ATK and stuns them for several seconds.
Periodically stops moving and gains a Barrier equal to a percentage of max HP (does not stack).
Burrows underground when HP drops below a certain threshold, gaining increased DEF and RES. After some time, disappears and moves to another stage.
[Earth Spike] Gains the following ability in Strange Territory Difficulty 4: Collision damage has a greater area and reduces targets' ATK.
[Deep Dive] Gains the following ability in Strange Territory Difficulty 6: When Movement Speed is at max, tiles it passes through are no longer deployable.

enemy_7059_xbrokz.description: Its long maw easily cleaves through rocks, while a casual flick of its tail stirs up dust clouds.
enemy_7059_xbrokz.lore: 'The ground's shaking! It's quaking! It's...' Before the observer can finish, the Quicksand Beast has already closed the distance. Its long maw easily cleaves through rocks, while a casual flick of its tail stirs up dust clouds. Within seconds, it burrows deep beneath the rock layers, leaving only dusty faces.

abilities.text: Helps your side when on the field; unblockable.
Movement speed gradually increases while moving (up to a max). Upon colliding with enemies, deals Physical damage equal to a percentage of ATK and stuns them for several seconds.
Can pick up Building Materials that it passes by (no limit).
[Earth Spike] Choose an allied Operator within range. Continuously stirs up mud and sand to grant a strong Barrier that gradually decays.
Rarer species have increased stats and enhanced [Earth Spike] Barrier.

enemy_18005_lhwand.description: Be it the guidance of blood or fate, he and his brothers eventually walked the same path, becoming another barrenlands horror story, rejecting life and embracing Originium.
enemy_18005_lhwand.lore: Be it the guidance of blood or fate, he and his brothers eventually walked the same path, becoming another barrenlands horror story, rejecting life and embracing Originium.

abilities.text: When unblocked, DEF and RES gradually increase while ATK decreases
When blocked, ATK and ASPD gradually increase while DEF and RES decrease
After several attacks, the next attack Stuns its target

enemy_18006_lhprie.description: She shall feed upon those whom she saved.
enemy_18006_lhprie.lore: Her piety and kindness were widely praised, and many owed their lives to her generosity. But that strength of spirit could not fend off physical transformation, and she shall feed upon those whom she saved when she awakens from her coffin.

abilities.text: First Form
Increases the Max HP of nearby enemies
When there are other enemies nearby, periodically heals 3 nearby enemies
Slowly recovers HP when defeated for the first time, and switches to 2nd form after some time; nearby enemies cannot be defeated during this time
Second Form
Stops healing other enemies
Periodically deals Arts damage to nearby allied units and inflicts Nervous Impairment

enemy_18007_lhbque.description: The queen of the pincerbugs, protected by giant pincerbugs, and reigning over the smaller pincerbugs. Her pheromone commands other pincerbugs to her will.
enemy_18007_lhbque.lore: The queen of the pincerbugs, protected by giant pincerbugs, and reigning over the smaller pincerbugs. Her pheromone commands other pincerbugs to her will. There is typically only one queen in a colony, as the previous queen will devolve when a new queen emerges. The reason why people call her 'Kaleidoqueen' will become apparent if you anger her.

abilities.text: Deals heavy Physical damage to surrounding allied units when all Pincerbugs are defeated
Periodically summons a Giant Pincerbug
Physical and Arts damage taken is reduced by a certain percentage for each Giant Pincerbug on the field
First Form
Summons 2 Giant Pincerbugs and slowly recovers HP when defeated for the first time, then switches to 2nd form after some time
Second Form
Becomes Aerial, Attack Interval greatly reduced, Movement Speed increased, and ATK greatly increased
Greatly increases the Max HP of other Infected Creatures on the field

enemy_18008_lhbbos.description: With Rhodes Island sunk and the Creator awakened, even the oldest laws have begun to change.
enemy_18008_lhbbos.lore: Other creatures are just as susceptible to infection as humans. Even the proudest hunter will turn to dust when its life comes to an end. With Rhodes Island sunk and the Creator awakened, however, even the oldest laws have begun to change.

abilities.text: First Form
Invisible; attacks deal splash damage in a cross area
After losing a certain percentage of HP, creates [Originium Formations] on deployable tiles around itself
Slowly recovers HP when defeated for the first time, and switches to 2nd form after some time
Second Form
Upon entering 2nd form, clears all retreatable tiles, and continuously moves deployable Operators and tiles to random deployable positions in random directions for a period of time
Loses Invisibility and performs ranged attacks, dealing Arts damage
On attack, [Originium Formations] deal damage to your nearby units

enemy_9013_acstmk.description:
A suit of steam armor that has been heavily corroded by Originium.
Corrosion is the most common form of Originium reaction.
enemy_9013_acstmk.lore: Steam armor thoroughly corrupted by Originium, an OpFor unit based on the scenario of a Terra-wide Originium disaster. As Originium spreads, courage, resolve and glory are turned to crystalline dust, leaving behind the armor, torn apart by crystals to march towards the fading light of the sunset.

abilities.text: Randomly selects a target and fires in a line, dealing Arts damage

[Woe of Extinction] Fires an Armor Piercer at the Operator with the highest ATK, which explodes when it reaches the target, stunning them and units in the 8 surrounding tiles for an extended time and causing them to take Physical damage every second; Armor Piercer can be destroyed by attacking it several times when it is flying
When HP drops below a certain percentage, Physical and Arts damage taken is reduced, and [Woe of Extinction] fires additional Armor Piercer
[Deathswarm] Periodically summons drones
Hidden Core

[Sword and Hammer of Olden Days] When specific conditions are met and the simulation enters the Hidden Core round, OpFor: Armor will appear in its final form and gain 'Armor Cleaver' and 'Armor Crusher'
'Armor Cleaver' and 'Armor Crusher' start Invulnerable; When shot down, transfer a percentage of the damage taken to OpFor: Armor

'Armor Cleaver' and 'Armor Crusher' periodically fly towards the Operator with the lowest ATK and explode, stunning the target and Operators in the 8 surrounding tiles, and dealing Physical damage every second before returning to OpFor: Armor; they lose Invulnerable status when flying and will fall to the ground after taking a certain number of hits; when on ground, they are treated as low ground units and take more damage

enemy_9017_achunt.description: Inflicts Corrosion when dealing damage; attacks prioritize enemies with high ATK and DEF; ASPD gradually increases when attacking the same target repeatedly
enemy_9017_achunt.lore: Holy Gun-Knight corrupted and reshaped by Originium, an OpFor unit based on the scenario of a Terra-wide Originium disaster. As Originium spreads, it seizes everything we revere and takes its place. It will be the new order when all others are shattered.

abilities.text: Attacks prioritize units with the highest DEF
Attacks inflict Corrosion
Cannot be blocked.
ASPD gradually increases when attacking the same enemy repeatedly
[Final Judgment] Stops attacking and gains greatly increased Movement Speed, charging at the unit with the highest DEF and dealing Physical damage to units it passes by
Hidden Core

[Unending Confession] After fulfilling specific conditions and entering the Hidden Core round in the simulation, 'Gunshatter' appears on the field, and Physical and Arts damage taken by OpFor: Gun is significantly reduced

[Blind Faith] Connects to all 'Gunshatters' on the field; a percentage of damage taken by 'Gunshatters' is transferred to OpFor: Gun, and allied units on the [Blind Faith] link take Physical damage every second
[Doomsaying] Continuously calls all 'Gunshatters' towards it; 'Gunshatters' gain greatly increased Movement Speed, become immune to damage, and deal damage to allied units that they pass by

enemy_9021_acduml.lore: The 'Empresses' Voice' recreated by Originium, an OpFor unit based on the scenario of a Terra-wide Originium disaster. As Originium spreads, it overcomes all praise and reproach, the echoes upon its surface merely another name for Originium.

abilities.text: When on the field, continuously summons 'Echoes' in [Penumbral Lament] form; summon interval reduces when HP drops below a certain point
Attacks prioritize 'Echoes' in [Penumbral Lament] form
[Cracked Pipe] Attacks all 'Echoes' in [Penumbral Lament] form three times in a row, dealing AoE Arts damage and inflicting Necrosis
Hidden Core
OpFor: String and OpFor: Pipe will appear at the same time after fulfilling specific conditions and entering the Hidden Core round
